note: Screen sequence of the interactive ESX installer and the DCUI (docs/spec/26-esx-install.md §4.1, §4.3; VCF 9.1.1 / ESX 9.1). Titles = screen / menu names the spec gives in bold; body lines = sentences quoted in the spec (documentation sentences, not guaranteed on-screen text, 26 header note). Screens whose on-screen text the spec does not document carry `simplified: true` (UI label 'zjednodušená obrazovka (herní)') and use neutral wording; key labels on simplified screens are game controls. Main installer path first; screens with `conditional: true` appear only in special cases (SD/USB boot device, deprecated CPU, failure) and should not count in the 'krok n / N' counter. specRefs put the [E..] ids before step tokens like I-10 so the source parser does not read '10' as a spec file. Actions are engine handlers (modes/sandbox/console.ts). Reviewed by scenario-designer (UX backlog S3).
versionNotes: Root password (26 §3.4): ESX 9.1 [E12] = length 7–128, all four character classes by default (an uppercase first character and a digit last character do not count, no user name). ESX 9.0 [E13] = length 7–39 ('less than 40'), at least three of the four classes. 'Required Information' 9.1 [E10] still says 'between 8 and 40 characters' – conflict, 26 §8 OQ4; the game uses [E12] (checkEsxRootPassword).
Installer sequence 9.0 [E5] = 9.1 [E4] (26 §4.1 [9.0]). DCUI 9.0 vs 9.1 not compared page by page (26 §8 OQ12).
VLAN ID: DCUI 'from 1 through 4094' [E22]; 'Required Information' [E10] says 0–4095 (26 §8 OQ6) – the console uses the DCUI range.

IPv4 item name: vSphere 9.1 [E23] 'IP Configuration' / 'Set static IP address and network configuration'; VCF 9.1 [E31] 'IPv4 Configuration' / 'Set static IPv4 address and network configuration'. The console follows the VCF page (26 §8 OQ11). IPv6 Configuration (dual-stack only, D-5d) is not offered – VCF infrastructure networks must be IPv4 (10 §3.2) and the order of the item in the menu is undocumented.

Not modelled as screens (no engine support / undocumented text): Confirm Disk Selection (I-6a, disk with data), choices for an existing ESX / VMFS (I-6b, option names undocumented, 26 §8 OQ2), BIOS/UEFI boot device (I-2, I-13), Troubleshooting Options (SSH / ESX Shell, 26 §4.4) and DCUI keys F4 / F12 / Alt+F1 / Alt+F2 / Alt+F12 / q.

installer.title: Welcome
body: press Enter to continue

installer.title: Select a Disk to Install or Upgrade
body: Press F1 for information about the selected disk.
Caution: Do not rely on the disk order in the list to select a disk.

installer.title: Keyboard type
body: You can change the keyboard type after installation in the direct console.

installer.title: Root password
body: Enter the root password
password length is at least 7 characters and at most 128
you must include a mix of at least one from each of the following four character classes
You can change the password after installation in the direct console.

installer.title: Confirm Install
body: Press F11 to confirm the start of the installation.

installer.title: Installation Complete
body: When the installation is complete, remove the installation CD, DVD, or USB flash drive.
Press Enter to reboot the host.

installer.title: Select a Disk to store ESX OSData
body: select a persistent storage device with minimum 32 GB of available space.

installer.title: CPU_SUPPORT_WARNING
body: CPU_SUPPORT_WARNING: The CPUs in this host may not be supported in future VCF releases. Plan accordingly.

dcui.title: Direct Console
body: The assigned IP address appears on the direct console.

dcui.title: Configure Password
body: password length is at least 7 characters and at most 128
you must include a mix of at least one from each of the following four character classes

dcui.title: VLAN (Optional)
body: from 1 through 4094

dcui.title: IPv4 Configuration
body: Set static IPv4 address and network configuration

body: Use the following DNS Server address and hostname

body: By default, DHCP acquires the DNS suffixes.

body: Press Escape to exit and press Y to confirm the changes.

dcui.title: Restart Management Network
body: Restarting the management network will result in a brief network outage
Press F11 to confirm the restart.
